limitations: One small sandbox repository and one model (Claude Sonnet 5.5).
Six tasks, twelve sessions per arm.
The fourth run on these tasks, after fixes made from the first three: development evidence, not a registered test.
The mod's steps were three a person approved; dead-end hits fell only by point estimate (0.75 against 1.17 per session, not shown).
